title: Up-Front Share of the Participation Fee When a Fine Arts Payment Plan Opens Late (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
**Plan opened late.** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a plan opened late carries part of the participation fee of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** up front by the calendar days from the registration date to the first installment: 50 percent of the participation fee net when there are more than 21 days, 25 percent when there are more than 14 but no more than 21 days, and none otherwise, each rounded to the nearest cent with half a cent rounding up.

| Calendar days from the registration date to the first installment | Part of the participation fee net carried up front |
|---|---|
| 0 to 14 | none |
| 15 to 21 | 25 percent |
| 22 or more | 50 percent |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical participation fee net of 47.30)

| Days | Up-front part |
|---|---|
| 14 | none |
| 15 | 25 percent: 11.825, rounded half up to 11.83 |
| 21 | 25 percent: 11.83 |
| 22 | 50 percent: 23.65 |
